{{Top|leg}}
'''Personal Data Journal Entry #461''' was an entry made into personal data journals owned by various high ranking members of the first Death Star. The commanding officer of the battlestation, Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin implemented a section into the journal entry, detailing the energy and propulsion systems aboard the Death Star, alongside that of [[Personal Data Journal Entry 481|Personal Data Journal Entry #481]].
